title: Turn battery icon red at actual user-configured critical threshold, rather than always at 20% remaining battery or less
line: The battery icon now turns red at the low battery level set in the power settings instead of always below 15%.
explanation: The battery icon's colour came only from the icon theme: Breeze's battery-010 and battery-000 icons are red, so the icon turned red below 15% whatever low battery level was set in the power settings (10% by default), and never turned red above 15% even if the low level was higher. The applet had no way to know that level, which only the powerdevil daemon read. Powerdevil now exposes its low battery level over D-Bus (batteryLowLevel method plus a change signal when the settings are reloaded), BatteryControlModel reads it, and BatteryIcon gets an optional lowPercent: above it the red icons are not used (the 20% icon is shown instead), at or below it the icon is tinted with the negative text colour, which turns the black icons red the same way Breeze's own low icons are.

commits.message:
components: let the battery icon turn red at a given charge level

The low battery icons are red in the icon theme, so the battery icon
turned red below 15% regardless of when the battery is considered low.
Add an optional low level to the battery icon and expose powerdevil's.

BUG: 492798

applets/batterymonitor: show the battery as low at the configured level

The battery icon turned red at the icon theme's fixed 15%, which didn't
match the low battery level set in the power settings. Expose that level
over D-Bus and use it to choose when the battery icon is shown as low.

BUG: 492798

media.caption: Before: battery at 12% with the default low level of 10%, the icon is already red
After: at 12% the icon stays normal (left), it turns red at 10% (right)
Before: low level set to 30%, battery at 25%, the icon stays black
After: same setting, the icon is red at 25%; it updated live when the setting changed
